fields.description: A flooded night elf ruin on the Zoram Strand, occupied by naga, murlocs and Twilight's Hammer cultists serving Aku'mai.
Someone has broken into the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge.
Troggs and Burning Blade cultists infest the molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar.
Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.
Archmage Arugal and his worgen followers hold the keep above Pyrewood Village.
The Defias Brotherhood is building a warship in the mines beneath Moonbrook.
Defias prisoners have overrun Stormwind's prison beneath the Canal District.
Deep beneath the Barrens, druids and fanglords guard the sleeping Naralex while twisted beasts prowl the caverns.
